title: Parts Velocity: the Units Sold info icon opens and closes as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "Parts Velocity" in the left list.
  3. Point at the info icon beside "Units Sold".
  4. Move the pointer away.
  5. Click the info icon.
  6. Click the info icon again.
  7. Press Tab until the info icon has focus.
  8. Press Escape.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • the explanation appears, starting "Units taken out of inventory stock on invoiced work orders in this date range."

Step 4:

  • it disappears.

Step 5:

  • it appears.

Step 6:

  • it disappears.

Step 7:

  • it appears.

Step 8:

  • it disappears.

Why this matters: The shared info icon was changed for the aging reports; other reports must keep it working.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/shell/ReportInfoIcon.vue:1-29; app/src/components/ts/reporting/shell/ReportInfoIcon.vue:75-91; app/src/components/ts/reporting/parts-velocity/PartsVelocityReport.vue:139-170. V1 code, quoted: `@click.stop="toggle" @keydown.esc.stop="hide" @focus="show" @blur="hide" @mouseenter="show" @mouseleave="hide"`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-200) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.
